_doc: Annotation sidecar for IDWriteFactory (most-derived IDWriteFactory8). The hand subclass IDWriteFactory.ts keeps the ergonomic convenience layer over this generated base. Skips below are methods the hand subclass re-expresses with a friendlier signature, or that the generic emitter can't lower safely.

IDWriteFactory.CreateTextFormat6._why: skipped so the bare createTextFormat name stays free for the hand ergonomic version (otherwise this axis-values variant would claim it); re-add by hand if variable-axis text formats are needed

IDWriteFactory.CreateGdiCompatibleTextLa._why: hand version defaults pixelsPerDip/useGdiNatural and passes a null transform (the generated one requires a DWRITE_MATRIX)

IDWriteFactory.CreateCustomRenderingPara._why: hand createCustomRenderingParams(opts) with sensible gamma/contrast/clearType/geometry/mode defaults
skipped so the bare createCustomRenderingParams name stays free for the hand version (the grayscale variant would otherwise claim it)
skipped so the bare createCustomRenderingParams name stays free for the hand version (the grid-fit variant would otherwise claim it)
skipped so the bare createCustomRenderingParams name stays free for the hand version

IDWriteFactory.CreateFontFileReference._why: hand createFontFileReference(filePath), single absolute WASI path, no lastWriteTime array

IDWriteFactory.CreateFontFace._why: hand createFontFace(type, files[], faceIndex?, sims?) takes the file array ergonomically; the generated one mis-lowers the IDWriteFontFile** array to a single out-object

IDWriteFactory.CreateGlyphRunAnalysis._why: the analysis references the glyph run until CreateAlphaTexture, so the run must outlive the call, the hand version allocates it persistently (the generated `using s` scope would free it early)
